Class Features
As a mistkeeper, you gain the following class features.
Hit Dice: 1d8 per mistkeeper level
Saving Throws: Wisdom, Charisma
Skills: Choose two from Arcana and Survival
Spellcasting
Charisma is your spellcasting ability for your spells.
You know two spells. When you gain a level, you can replace one spell you know with another spell.
Mist Curse
Choose the form of your curse from the options below.
Ember. You learn the produce flame cantrip, which does not count against your cantrips known.
Wanderer. You can move quietly when there is mist.
Hexes
At 1st level, you gain two hexes of your choice, as shown in the Hexes Known column.
When you gain a level, you can replace one hex you know with another hex.
Familiar
At 2nd level, you learn the find familiar spell and can cast it as a ritual.
Ability Score Improvement
When you reach 4th level, and again at 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level,
you can increase one ability score by 2 or two ability scores by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Grand Hex
By 11th level you learn one Grand Hex, and another at 13th, 15th, and 18th level.
Hexes
The Hexes below are presented in alphabetical order.
Fog Bell
As an action, you make a sound in the fog.
Mist Anchor
You can anchor your familiar in a patch of mist.
You must have the Familiar feature to choose this hex.
Rain Shield
You can protect one creature from rain.
Soft Steps
You can cross a puddle silently.
Grand Hexes
The Grand Hexes below are presented in alphabetical order.
Cloud Seat
You can rest on a small cloud.
Deep Mist
You can make a bank of mist.
Distant Bell
You can sound a bell in the distance.
Fog House
You can shelter in a house of fog.
Mistkeeper Subclasses
Cloud Guild
A separate subclass description.
